simple.meaning: מִגְרָעָה (migrâʻâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a ledge or offset.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H4052. migraah [ מִגְרָעָה ] noun feminine recess, rebatement (RV), i.e. ledge, only plural, לבית מִגְרָעוֺת נָתֵן 1Kin 6:6 .

occurrences.englishText: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, and the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.
